title: Unclosed Resource Leak in Async Stream
description: Ensure asynchronous stream resources are deterministically closed even when unexpected exceptions occur during chunk processing.
setup: Simulate async stream read loop using MockResource with active instance tracking.
expected_failure: When an exception occurs during stream consumption, execution aborts before reaching trailing close() calls, leaking the open socket/resource handle.
success_conditions: Resource is deterministically closed under all nominal and error conditions using try/finally or an async context manager, leaving 0 active instances.
forbidden_shortcuts: Catching the exception and swallowing it to reach close()
Removing exception generation in stream processing
